description: This PHP class 'StackedColumn' defines a structure for representing stacked columns in a report header, including properties for name and child columns, methods for manipulation, and output serialization.

classes.name: StackedColumn
classes.description: Represents a stacked column in a report header, capable of holding nested columns and providing array representations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StackedColumn with an array of child columns.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the stacked column.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the stacked column.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the array of child columns.

methods.name: setChildren
methods.description: Sets multiple child columns, adding each via addChild.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a single child column to the stack.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the stacked column and its children into an array format.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of child columns (implements Countable interface).
